prompt: Which president featured on a U.S. coin in 1972 served the longest as President of the United States of America?
answer: Franklin D. Roosevelt. He was featured on the U.S. dime in 1972 and served as president from 1933 to 1945—more than 12 years, the longest presidency in U.S. history.
